message.jaymoskingdoms.patron.strict.on: You keep strict faith: a broken commandment costs twice, and neglect has no floor. /patron strict false to ease it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.patron.strict.off: Your faith is not strict. /patron strict true to keep it strictly: a broken commandment costs twice, and neglect has no floor.
message.jaymoskingdoms.patron.strict.ser: Strict faith holds for everyone on this server.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.blasphemy.cry.1: You spit on %s before my eyes? Out!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.blasphemy.cry.2: Blasphemy! I'll not know you again, not before %s.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cast_out.refuse.0: You're cast out. I've nothing to say to you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cast_out.refuse.2: Not a word. Not a coin. Go.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cleanse.cry.1: Unclean! The Truth will see you cleansed!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cleanse.cry.2: I know what you are! To arms, all of you!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cleanse.hunt.0: There it is! Don't let it go!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cleanse.hunt.2: Unclean thing! Out of our streets!
gamerule.jaymoskingdoms.patron_strict_fa: Everyone keeps strict faith (broken commandments cost twice, neglect has no floor)
